title: Make-Up Amount on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
**Make-up amount (Home Comfort Financing).** The make-up amount is the installment still owed plus the pulled-forward share of the next installment, rounded to the cent half up only at the end. The installment still owed is the account's monthly payment less the payments posted less than one whole month before the date of handling, never below zero, and nothing of the next installment is pulled forward.

## Inputs and result

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Monthly payment | the account record, as set at funding |
| Payments posted less than one whole month before the date of handling | the account's payment entries, summed |
| Pulled-forward share of the next installment | nothing |

The installment still owed is the monthly payment less that sum, and never below zero; the make-up amount is that figure plus nothing pulled forward, rounded once at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical, monthly payment $238.47)

| Payments posted in the last month | Installment still owed | Make-up amount |
|---|---|---|
| none | $238.47 | $238.47 |
| $100.00 | $138.47 | $138.47 |
| $238.47 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| $300.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) | $0.00 |

A payment posted six weeks before the date of handling is more than one whole month old and does not reduce the installment still owed.
